db = value["db"]
	parentID = value["parentID"]
	
	if parentID != None:		
		whereParent = "AND ParentNodeID = {}".format(parentID)
	else:
		whereParent = ""
	
	query = """	SELECT ID, Name FROM node WHERE Type = ? {}	""".format(whereParent)

enterpriseId  = value["entID"]
	siteId        = value["sitID"]
	areaId        = value["areID"]
	lineId        = value["linID"]
	workstationId = value["wksID"]
	rol           = value["rol"]
	db            = value["db"]
	
	# Si el rol es false y el workstationId es 0, retornar una lista vacía
	if rol == "false" and workstationId == 0:
	    return []
	
	# WHERE simple (agrega solo lo que sea "truthy": None/0/"" NO filtran)
	where = "WHERE 1=1"
	if workstationId:
	    where += " AND ws.ID = {}".format(int(workstationId))
	if enterpriseId:
	    where += " AND entN.ID = {}".format(int(enterpriseId))
	if siteId:
	    where += " AND siteN.ID = {}".format(int(siteId))
	if areaId:
	    where += " AND areaN.ID = {}".format(int(areaId))
	if lineId:
	    where += " AND lineN.ID = {}".format(int(lineId))
	
	query = """
	SELECT 
	    ws.ID AS WorkstationID, 
	    wsn.ID AS WorkstationNodeID, 
	    n.ID AS NodeID, 
	    p.ID AS PapoID, 
	    p.Description AS PapoName, 
	    p.Reference AS Reference, 
	    -- Acción: del último item del JSON (si existe), si no, la del RegisterType de la fila 
	    COALESCE(lastRH.SourceAction, lastRH.FallbackAction) AS Action, 
	
	    lastRH.[User] AS [User], 
	    lastRH.[Timestamp] AS [Timestamp], 
	    lastRH.[Status] AS [Status], 
	    lastRH.SourceRegisterTypeID, 
	    lastRH.RegisterCode, -- Agregamos registerCode para obtener el último 
	    DATEDIFF(MINUTE, lastRH.[Timestamp], GETDATE()) AS MinutesSince
	
	FROM workstation ws 
	JOIN workstationnode wsn ON wsn.WorkstationID = ws.ID 
	JOIN node n ON n.ID = wsn.NodeID
	
	-- Jerarquía por Type (para filtros)
	LEFT JOIN node lineN ON lineN.Type = 'LINE' 
	    AND lineN.ID = CASE 
	        WHEN n.Type = 'LINE' THEN n.ID 
	        WHEN n.Type = 'CELL' THEN n.ParentNodeID 
	        ELSE NULL 
	    END
	LEFT JOIN node areaN ON areaN.Type = 'AREA' 
	    AND areaN.ID = CASE WHEN lineN.ID IS NOT NULL THEN lineN.ParentNodeID ELSE NULL END
	LEFT JOIN node siteN ON siteN.Type = 'SITE' 
	    AND siteN.ID = CASE WHEN areaN.ID IS NOT NULL THEN areaN.ParentNodeID ELSE NULL END
	LEFT JOIN node entN ON entN.Type = 'ENTERPRISE' 
	    AND entN.ID = CASE WHEN siteN.ID IS NOT NULL THEN siteN.ParentNodeID ELSE NULL END
	
	-- Relación Papo ↔ Node 
	JOIN nodepapo np ON np.NodeID = n.ID 
	JOIN papo p ON p.ID = np.PapoID
	
	-- Último registro + último registerTypeID del JSON
	OUTER APPLY (
	    SELECT TOP (1)
	        rh.[User], 
	        rh.[Timestamp], 
	        rh.[Status], 
	        
	        -- Fallback: descripción del RegisterTypeID de la fila 
	        rt.[Description] AS FallbackAction,
	
	        -- Del JSON: último items[].registerTypeID
	        js.SourceRegisterTypeID, 
	        rts.[Description] AS SourceAction,
	
	        -- Incluir el registerCode
	        rh.RegisterCode
	
	    FROM registerhistory rh 
	    JOIN registertype rt ON rt.ID = rh.RegisterTypeID 
	    OUTER APPLY (
	        SELECT TOP(1)
	            TRY_CAST(JSON_VALUE(j.value, '$.registerTypeID') AS INT) AS SourceRegisterTypeID 
	        FROM OPENJSON(rh.DataAnswer, '$.items') AS j 
	        ORDER BY j.[key] DESC
	    ) js 
	    LEFT JOIN registertype rts ON rts.ID = js.SourceRegisterTypeID 
	    WHERE rh.WorkstationNodeID = wsn.ID 
	      AND rh.PapoID = p.ID 
	    ORDER BY rh.RegisterCode DESC, rh.[Timestamp] DESC
	) AS lastRH
	
	{where};
	""".format(where=where)
	
	ds = system.db.runQuery(query, db)
	
	rows = []
	if ds:
	    for i in range(ds.getRowCount()):
	        ts = ds.getValueAt(i, "Timestamp")
	        ts_str = system.date.format(ts, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") if ts is not None else None
	        rows.append({
	            "workstationID":       ds.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationID"),
	            "workstationnodeID":   ds.getValueAt(i, "WorkstationNodeID"),
	            "nodeID":              ds.getValueAt(i, "NodeID"),
	            "papoID":              ds.getValueAt(i, "PapoID"),
	            "name":                ds.getValueAt(i, "PapoName"),
	            "reference":           ds.getValueAt(i, "Reference"),
	            "action":              ds.getValueAt(i, "Action"),
	            "status":              ds.getValueAt(i, "Status"),
	            "user":                ds.getValueAt(i, "User"),
	            "timestamp":           ts_str,
	            "minutesSince":        int(ds.getValueAt(i, "MinutesSince") or 0),
	        })
	
	    # Ordenar de más a menos por MinutesSince
	    rows.sort(key=lambda x: x["minutesSince"], reverse=True)
	
	return rows

if value is None:
	    return []
	
	value = value.replace("&", "")
	
	results = system.tag.browse(value).getResults()
	instances = []
	
	for tag in results:
	    if str(tag["tagType"]) == "UdtInstance":
	        udt_name = tag["name"] or ""
	        udt_path = "%s/%s" % (value, udt_name)
	
	        cpk_path = udt_path + "/CpK"
	        ppk_path = udt_path + "/PpK"
	        lsl_path = udt_path + "/LSL"
	        usl_path = udt_path + "/USL"
	        sp_path  = udt_path + "/SP"
	
	        try:
	            values = system.tag.readBlocking([cpk_path, ppk_path, lsl_path, usl_path, sp_path])
	            cpk = values[0].value if values[0].quality.isGood() else 0
	            ppk = values[1].value if values[1].quality.isGood() else 0
	            lsl = values[2].value if values[2].quality.isGood() else 0
	            usl = values[3].value if values[3].quality.isGood() else 0
	            sp  = values[4].value if values[4].quality.isGood() else 0
	        except:
	            cpk, ppk, lsl, usl, sp = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	
	        cpk = cpk if cpk is not None else 0
	        ppk = ppk if ppk is not None else 0
	        lsl = lsl if lsl is not None else 0
	        usl = usl if usl is not None else 0
	        sp  = sp  if sp  is not None else 0
	
	        instance = {
	            "instanceStyle":    {"classes": ""},
	            "instancePosition": {},
	            "cpk":              cpk,
	            "cpp":              ppk,
	            "lsl":              lsl,
	            "usl":              usl,
	            "sp":               sp,
	            "fontZise":         14,
	            "name":             udt_name
	        }
	
	        instances.append(instance)
	
	return instances

transforms.code:
ds = value["ds"]        # Dataset
	targetID = value["id"]  # El ID que estás buscando
	
	# --- Buscar la fila donde la columna "ID" coincide ---
	rowIndex = -1
	for i in range(ds.getRowCount()):
	    if ds.getValueAt(i, "ID") == targetID:
	        rowIndex = i
	        break
	
	# --- Si lo encontró, obtén el valor que quieras (por nombre o índice) ---
	if rowIndex != -1:
	    valor = ds.getValueAt(rowIndex, "Name")  # o por nombre de columna: ds.getValueAt(rowIndex, "Description")
	else:
	    valor = None  # No se encontró el ID
	
	return valor

messageHandlers.script:
logging.log("Received message", "info")
	# Inicializar lista si no existe
	if not hasattr(self.custom, 'enabledReferences'):
		self.custom.enabledReferences = []
	
	enabledReferences = list(self.custom.enabledReferences)
	pathSource = payload['pathSource']
	
	# Buscar si ya existe
	existing = next((p for p in enabledReferences if p.get('pathSource') == pathSource), None)
	
	if payload['enabledOrDisabled']:
		enabledReferences = []
		# Agregar si no existe
		if not existing:
			enabledReferences.append({
				"name": payload['name'],
				"unit": payload['unit'],
				"pathSource": pathSource,
				"group": payload['group'],
				"color": payload['color'],
				"form": payload['form']
			})
	else:
		# Eliminar si existe
		if existing:
			enabledReferences.remove(existing)
	
	# Guardar cambios
	self.custom.enabledReferences = enabledReferences

logger = system.util.getLogger("refreshPeriodic")
	_min = payload['min']
	self.view.custom.refreshPeriodic = _min
	logger.info("Overview_Papos/root/script refreshPeriodic ejecuted")
